title: Rational design and biological validation of EZH2/PD-L1 bifunctional inhibitors for colorectal cancer immunotherapy.
authors: Guan, Bingsheng; Cheng, Binbin; Li, Hongqiao
one_liner_zh: 该文设计并验证靶向PD-L1和EZH2的双功能小分子抑制剂，虽涉及分子模拟但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aims to identify novel small-molecule inhibitors that target both PD-L1 and EZH2 to enhance colorectal cancer immunotherapy. METHODS: A combination of computer-aided molecular simulation, homogeneous time-resolved fluorescence (HTRF) assays, biolayer interferometry (BLI) assays, microscale thermophoresis (MST), and MTase-Glo methyltransferase assays was used to identify compounds with dual-targeting potential. RESULTS: Compound PE-1 exhibited potent inhibitory activity against the PD-1/PD-L1 interaction (IC(50) = 48.1 nM) and showed strong EZH2 methyltransferase inhibitory effects, with an IC(50) of 101.2 nM. BLI and MST further confirmed that PE-1 can effectively bind to both PD-L1 and EZH2 at the molecular level, supporting its bifunctional targeting capability. Importantly, compound PE-1 demonstrated significant activity in a PD-1/PD-L1 NFAT reporter bioassay, dose-dependently enhancing luciferase activity (EC(50) = 0.61 muM), indicating effective blockade of the PD-1/PD-L1 pathway and reactivation of T-cell NFAT signaling. Notably, PE-1 demonstrated favorable in vivo pharmacokinetic properties, including a satisfactory oral bioavailability of 58.4%. In syngeneic tumor models, oral administration of PE-1 elicited substantial anti-tumor efficacy, with tumor growth inhibition (TGI) reaching 69.9% in CT26 tumors. CONCLUSIONS: PE-1 demonstrates dual-target inhibitory activity against the PD-1/PD-L1 immune checkpoint and EZH2, underscoring its potential as a lead compound for the development of next-generation bifunctional anticancer agents.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在识别靶向PD-L1和EZH2的新型小分子抑制剂，以增强结直肠癌免疫治疗。方法：结合计算机辅助分子模拟、均相时间分辨荧光（HTRF）实验、生物层干涉（BLI）实验、微量热泳动（MST）和MTase-Glo甲基转移酶实验，用于识别具有双靶点潜力的化合物。结果：化合物PE-1对PD-1/PD-L1相互作用表现出强效抑制活性（IC(50) = 48.1 nM），并对EZH2甲基转移酶显示出强抑制效果，其IC(50)为101.2 nM。BLI和MST进一步证实，PE-1能在分子水平上有效结合PD-L1和EZH2，支持其双功能靶向能力。重要的是，化合物PE-1在PD-1/PD-L1 NFAT报告基因生物测定中表现出显著活性，剂量依赖性地增强荧光素酶活性（EC(50) = 0.61 μM），表明其有效阻断PD-1/PD-L1通路并重新激活T细胞NFAT信号。值得注意的是，PE-1显示出良好的体内药代动力学特性，包括令人满意的口服生物利用度58.4%。在同基因肿瘤模型中，口服PE-1产生了显著的抗肿瘤效果，在CT26肿瘤中肿瘤生长抑制（TGI）达到69.9%。结论：PE-1对PD-1/PD-L1免疫检查点和EZH2表现出双靶点抑制活性，突显其作为开发下一代双功能抗癌药物先导化合物的潜力。
